messages:
maya.chen: FYI after int4 quant on q4b-multilang we saw ~4% uptick in deid false positives for short prompts (<32 tok). appears in arabic and devanagari samples.
arjun.patel: token boundaries changed in int4 tokenmap recompute, short strings split differently. quick repro attached.
sam.k: did dedupe pipeline drop nfkc? that would explain fingerprint drift.
maya.chen: correct 12 int4 CI used tokenizer v2 without nfkc+casefold; fp32 baseline normalized.
priya.rao: will need a small audit. can we get a 200-sample micro set + manifest?
arjun.patel: created s3://redwood-ci/q4b/int4/tokenmap_flagged/fails.csv. refingerprint command: `python3 scripts/tools/refingerprint.py --norm nfkc --casefold --tokenizer v2 --input s3://.../fails.csv --output s3://.../refingered.csv`
label-ops-bot: Created label job 5242 owner priya.rao, 2000 samples, tag: multilang-tokenmap-audit. ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:
priya.rao: assigning to native linguists first pass, then ML review.
sam.k: i'll run baseline vs int4 diffs on the 200-sample micro-audit and attach to label job. threshold: if deid FP >2% rollback int4 for multilang.
maya.chen: action items: arjun -> refingerprint + micro set, priya -> label job lead, sam -> diff evals. add nfkc pre-fingerprint to int4 CI as canary opt-in. hold golden_v3 until audit completes.
label-ops-bot: Label job 5242 status: queued. worker allocation ETA ~1.5h.
maya.chen: thanks all. will review audit results once labels are in.
